purpose: Configure per-user quiet-hours / do-not-disturb windows while retaining an optional, propose-only Helix advisor and policy explanations.
primaryGoal: Review configured schedules and bypass rules; create, edit or delete a window using the deterministic form. AI suggestions may prefill a draft but never persist it.

dataSources.name: useQuietHours
dataSources.behavior: notification-quiet-hours query key shared by page and panel; request receives AbortSignal; response.windows normalized with safeArray; STALE_TIMES.MODERATE. Summary receives the parent's query, not a separate query.
dataSources.backendVerification: NOT INSPECTED: endpoint strings and methods are frontend source evidence, not router or live-server verification.

dataSources.name: useSaveQuietHours / useDeleteQuietHours
dataSources.behavior: Positive numeric id selects PATCH; otherwise POST. Both save and delete invalidate and broadcast notification-quiet-hours. Hooks emit mutation toasts in addition to the panel's per-call toasts.
dataSources.backendVerification: NOT INSPECTED; per-user authorization, server timezone behavior and validation remain unknown.

dataSources.name: useAiStream
dataSources.behavior: SSE POST adds the /api/v1 prefix in the hook, sends an empty object and uses auth headers, server credentials and AbortSignal. Advisor captures successful draft_quiet_hours_window tool_result frames, filters severity elements to strings, cancels on unmount and applies only typed draft scalars.
dataSources.backendVerification: NOT INSPECTED. Trailing 30-day aggregate history and privacy claims appear in advisor copy/comments; actual server aggregation and privacy enforcement are not proved.

dataSources.name: AI feature enablement
dataSources.behavior: Existing useAiEnabled(feature) gate returns null when disabled. Preserve this intentional AI-off boundary while retaining the deterministic panel and guide.
dataSources.backendVerification: Enablement hook/provider and configuration endpoints not expanded in this atomic audit.

dataSources.name: Browser clock and timezone
dataSources.behavior: Summary uses browser-local getHours/getDay; panel next-change labels do likewise. Draft defaults resolve the browser IANA timezone or UTC. These are independent business scheduling times, not workspace date/vehicle scope.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Forwards PageContainer props; w-full min-w-0 @container child stack. PageContainer internals were not expanded.

components.name: QuietHoursSummary
components.kind: feature presentation and derived policy summary
components.contract: Four metrics, initial-load skeleton, fatal retry and retained-data stale warning. Uses current shared operational metric pipeline; do not create a competing KPI renderer.

components.name: QuietHoursPanel
components.contract: Retain this sole deterministic save owner; do not fork a notifications-specific form. Owns default drafts, validation, list actions and both confirmations.

components.name: AIQuietHoursSuggestion
components.contract: Optional gated advisor; applies a proposal only to the form. Captured proposal includes insufficient-history and existing-window context.

components.name: AIFeatureCard
components.contract: Existing shared Helix CTA, translated accessible name, streaming disabled/busy state and AiOutputPanel delegation. This consumer uses buttonPlacement=below.

components.name: QuietHoursGuide
components.contract: Labelled region, three guidance steps and three severity explanations. No query or data requirement.

components.name: IconBox
components.contract: Panel and guide both pass purple. Applies mapped background/ring/text, not mapped glow.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Keep current animation owner; no page-local motion engine. Effective reduced-motion behavior unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / mission 33: one mutation feedback owner
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Panel success/error callbacks emit toasts while useSaveQuietHours and useDeleteQuietHours already emit them at useNotifications.ts:1394-1399,1411-1413. Two feedback paths exist for the same mutations; actual duplicate toast rendering was not exercised.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Choose one existing feedback owner without changing mutation/invalidation behavior; preserve contextual success and error details once.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: Mission 33 / MDC-045: domain derivation must have a consistent owner
duplicatedPatterns.detail: HH:MM parsing and clock-based schedule derivation also exist in QuietHoursPanel.tsx:145,160-184. Summary credits overnight time to yesterday; panel next-change checks only today's weekday. These related policies can diverge.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate only the shared schedule/time interpretation into a typed domain helper after confirming server semantics, leaving queries and localized labels in existing owners.

sourceStrategy: Page: single column until xl, then CRUD spans two columns and advisor/guide occupy one; min-w-0 on both branches (QuietHoursPage.tsx:64-75).
Panel: wrapping headers/actions, break-words/overflow-wrap window labels, wrapping weekday chips and form actions; time fields stack until sm (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:395-417,450-501,527-568,657-684).
Guide: severity rows use flex with a shrink-0 badge and flowing Text, but real translated narrow-width wrapping is unverified (QuietHoursGuide.tsx:112-121).

AI card: wrapping header/action rows and break-words title/description; proposal preview has raw lists without explicit overflow wrapping (AIFeatureCard.tsx:317-349; AIQuietHoursSuggestion.tsx:231-276).

issues.rule: MDC-043: preserve full content at narrow allocated widths
issues.detail: Proposal timezone, severity list and explanatory text have no explicit anywhere-wrapping/min-width treatment in the raw preview list. Overflow with long source strings is a source-indicated risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Use existing Text roles and safe wrapping in the preview; retain every proposal field and warning. Verify 320px and xl right-rail container widths with long locale/source content.

sourceStrengths: Summary has a localized section label; loading/fatal states keep the named section (QuietHoursSummary.tsx:129-140).
Guide useId ties region and severity list to localized labels; decorative guide/summary icons are aria-hidden (QuietHoursGuide.tsx:32-33,84-90,112; QuietHoursSummary.tsx:105-125).
Weekday/severity editing uses fieldset/legend, aria-pressed and min-h-11/min-w-11; weekday error association and assertive validation announcement are present (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:583-654).
Existing shared Input/Select/Toggle and ConfirmDialog owners are used; no raw button/input/select controls in the scoped source.
Helix CTA has a contextual aria-label, aria-disabled and streaming aria-busy (AIFeatureCard.tsx:296-301).

issues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-025: do not encode selection by color alone
issues.detail: Read-only weekday chips display all seven labels and indicate configured days only through tint/ring/weight. Unlike editor buttons, these spans have no programmatic selected-day text or aria-pressed.
issues.fix: Retain all weekday information and add localized selected/unselected or aggregate schedule text with a non-color cue; editor button semantics remain unchanged.

unverified: Actual control sizes outside explicitly sized weekday/severity buttons

states.loading: Summary initial no-data loading gives four-card skeleton (QuietHoursSummary.tsx:90,129-130); panel SourceContent initial gives two-row ListSkeleton (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:425-435).
states.empty: Summary zero known schedules, missing enabled/bypass context and No schedules status (QuietHoursSummary.tsx:103-125,150-151); panel explanatory EmptyState with Add window header action retained (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:384-390,410-419,437-441).
states.fatalError: Summary QueryError with query.refetch (QuietHoursSummary.tsx:132-136); panel error SourceContent with retry (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:425-431). Guide and deterministic draft form are not page-level gated by data.
states.refreshErrorAndStale: Summary StaleRefreshWarning plus provenance badge and stale status; panel maps stale to retained (QuietHoursSummary.tsx:141,148-156; QuietHoursPanel.tsx:425). Exact inherited offline/partial handling was not expanded.
states.mutation: Save pending controls, validation errors, toast success/error, delete pending per row and destructive confirmation; cancel uses dirty-draft confirmation (QuietHoursPanel.tsx:281-362,641-688).
states.ai: Advisor idle/streaming/paused-confirm/done/error come from useAiStream and AIFeatureCard. Applying is disabled while streaming/paused; feature-off intentionally hides only advisor. Proposal warnings/context retained (AIQuietHoursSuggestion.tsx:169-181,210-279,294-298).

issues.detail: Right now status is memoized only on windows identity. There is no clock dependency or timer, so crossing a time boundary without changed window data can leave the computed status unchanged. Panel labels also update only on render.
issues.fix: Use a bounded shared/domain clock or next-boundary refresh and retain query provenance separately from schedule-time freshness; do not imply notification-delivery verification.

issues.detail: List directly accesses w.bypass_severities.length and .map at lines 504-507 while draft and summary already tolerate missing lists. The TS type requires an array, but runtime null/missing fields are not normalized here; backend occurrence is unknown.
issues.fix: Normalize this optional runtime list once per row or at the existing typed data adapter, preserving a genuinely empty bypass list as no allowed severities.

issues.detail: AI seed effect unconditionally replaces draft and resets initialDraft/editingId. startEdit/startCreate also replace drafts directly; the discard guard is called only for Cancel. Applying another proposal while dirty can discard manual changes without that existing guard.
issues.fix: Route replacement actions through the existing dirty-draft confirmation before consuming a seed or replacing edits; preserve one-shot seed consumption and explicit Save-only persistence.

visualIssues.detail: Guide and CRUD panel purple IconBox callsites inherit bg-neon-purple/10 and ring-neon-purple/20 through tokens.ts:24. This is decorative heading chrome. IconBox does not apply the map's glow property; no actual icon-box glow is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Existing shared IconBox/token owner should provide subdued neutral/theme-semantic icon chrome while keeping size/color compatibility and saved theme/chart choices intact.

visualIssues.detail: Helix action imposes cyan-400 borders/focus, cyan-500 backgrounds and dark cyan-100 text rather than inherited outline treatment. AIBadge at line 217 also supplies fixed cyan tinted chrome. Saturation and theme contrast are source concerns, not measured failures.
visualIssues.fix: Subdue shared CTA/badge chrome through existing semantic control tokens, retaining meaningful Helix identity, focus visibility, contextual accessible names and busy/disabled states.

visualIssues.detail: Proposal uses text-sm/text-xs/font-medium raw wrappers and fixed emerald-300 text across themes. The explanatory preview is not a measured success state; weekday read-only chips also impose purple-300 body text at QuietHoursPanel.tsx:495.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing Text/PanelTitle roles and theme-aware primary/secondary text with restrained semantic warning treatment; preserve all preview and weekday content.

architectureIssues.detail: Configured windows carry timezone, but summary uses browser-local clock/weekday and never reads w.timezone. Panel next-change labels also use browser-local time and ignore previous-day overnight eligibility at QuietHoursPanel.tsx:160-178. Current copy explicitly says local weekday/time; equivalence with configured IANA timezone/server suppression is not proved.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm authoritative server semantics before consolidating a timezone-aware domain derivation; keep HH:MM/IANA timezone/weekday bitmask raw and distinct from workspace dates. Preserve overnight behavior and accurate unknown status rather than claiming browser time equals policy time.

architectureIssues.detail: nextWindowChangeLabel returns hardcoded English starts at / ends at / ends tomorrow at / starts tomorrow at, then renders directly at line 459. Summary/row bypass also expose raw warn/critical/info identifiers as display text.
architectureIssues.fix: Return structured transition data and render through current localized catalogs; reuse existing severity translation mappings while retaining raw request identifiers.

priority.reason: Source-confirmed timezone/clock consistency, unguarded draft replacement and runtime array assumptions outrank decorative modernization.
